opening.argument: The video is presented as a structured beginner lesson in digital marketing, with the title identifying a “Full Course for Beginners” and the speaker explaining that the series is intended for small business owners and people starting careers in digital marketing. It provides substantive instruction, including an explanation that search engine optimization can improve a website’s ranking in search engines. References to affiliate marketing are part of that educational framework, with the material defining commissions earned by promoting another company’s products. Although the description invites viewers to “Enroll Now for Digital Marketing Course,” it also calls the program free. Nothing in the available material shows that enrollment requires payment, requests credentials, guarantees returns, or connects viewers to a harmful mechanism.
